variants.asks: the vacuum splits every neutral point every tick. How fast does empty space actually grow, in this theory?

probes.asks: the vacuum splits a point into two halves facing each other across an edge. What does this theory's meeting rule leave of them?
probes.found: ANNIHILATION leaves something behind in 0 of the 1 states a facing pair can be in - neutral meets neutral: both gone

measured.name: cases
measured.note: every combination the two ends can be carrying in G - no sign to carry, so one. Enumerated, not sampled

measured.name: surviving
measured.note: applying ANNIHILATION to each: neutral meets neutral: both gone

measured.name: annihilating
measured.note: the states in which ANNIHILATION left nothing at all: 1 of 1

probes.asks: what rewrites is this theory made of, what is each one quantified over, and what must be there before it fires?
probes.found: G: EMISSION over each Local, gated on "source"; CREATION over each Local; MOVEMENT over the world; ARRIVAL over the world; ANNIHILATION over a chain of Boundary, Boundary, gated on "active"; TRANSPORT over the world

measured.name: rewrites
measured.note: G is made of these, read off the theory itself: EMISSION over each Local, gated on "source"; CREATION over each Local; MOVEMENT over the world; ARRIVAL over the world; ANNIHILATION over a chain of Boundary, Boundary, gated on "active"; TRANSPORT over the world

steps.because: the split fires on a point because the point is NEUTRAL, and it does not ask what this theory's rays carry - so every neutral point makes one point every tick, in every theory here. That is the rate space is made at, and it is the same number whatever is running
1 has nothing left in it that varies, so it is 1 exactly
